No consolidated statements of comprehensive income (revenue, operating income) block was delivered.
Revenue for FY2023 and the presented comparative year FY2022 is not established in the supplied blocks; the income statement block is missing.
Operating income for FY2023 and FY2022 is not established in the supplied blocks; the income statement block is missing.

Operating cash flow (net cash provided by operating activities) for FY2023 and FY2022 is not established in the supplied blocks; the consolidated statements of cash flows block and its period captions are missing.
Cash purchases of property, plant and equipment for FY2023 and FY2022 are not established in the supplied blocks; the investing-activities section and its note references are not delivered.
The table is marked '(Continued)' (block-001125-2ea6a4cb, page F - 4), so the equity-and-liabilities portion of the same balance sheet and adjacent notes were not delivered in this batch.
No FY2021 comparative appears in the delivered table; the period catalog lists fy2021 but no FY2021 figures are present in these blocks.

The accounting framework wording (e.g., IFRS as endorsed in the R.O.C. or US GAAP) is not stated in the supplied blocks; accounting_basis is set to reported_consolidated based on the 'CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF FINANCIAL POSITION' heading only.
Dashes ('-') appear in the delivered table (e.g., hedging financial assets, noncurrent FVTPL for 2022) and are not treated as zero.
Whether these consolidated financial statements are the original audited FY2023 statements or a re-presentation cannot be confirmed from the supplied blocks alone.
